subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` value now through this doctor migration, or preserve the contract until a real gRPC exporter exists?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but only an owner can authorize intentionally narrowing a shipped config contract and potentially disabling telemetry during upgrade repair.

options.title: Retire gRPC now
options.body: Approve the HTTP/protobuf-only contract and current doctor migration because `grpc` never exported telemetry and the migration preserves the effective behavior with an actionable recovery path.

options.title: Preserve the contract
options.body: Do not merge this direction; retain the accepted value until real gRPC export or another owner-approved compatibility strategy is implemented.

recommendation.title: Retire gRPC now
recommendation.body: Approve the HTTP/protobuf-only contract and current doctor migration because `grpc` never exported telemetry and the migration preserves the effective behavior with an actionable recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad ownership of diagnostics OTel runtime, configuration, health, endpoint, and packaging behavior.
